scope: Explicit interactive research display; no production age API, global capability or real fractional-age generation
decision_basis: The preceding frozen 98-case BLEND experiment found a MASK/BLEND source-point jump. This policy is chosen after inspecting those development results and is not independent evaluation.

source_contract.original_assets: Retain original GLB and PNG bytes separately and unchanged.
source_contract.source_pixels: At an exact known research source label return the original anchor RGBA object without interpolation or rounding.
source_contract.display_policy: Use one consistent BLEND material policy at every displayed target, including the exact source point. The display is a derivative and is not identical to the original MASK rendering.
source_contract.export: Export the research display derivative with explicit metadata; do not describe reserialized display GLB as original-source file bytes.
source_contract.exit_research_mode: Restore original maps and complete material transparency/depth state and release owned research resources.

age_policy.fractional: Preserve finite decimal labels, including 42.5; never silently round or clamp.
age_policy.unknown: No original-age anchor without a known research label; SAM target-condition interpolation does not infer API source age.
age_policy.same_age_conflict: The original source anchor wins over a same-age SAM anchor; other duplicate-age ambiguity is rejected.
age_policy.coverage: Reject extrapolation outside the actual supplied anchors.

numerical_policy.color: Linear-light premultiplied RGB and alpha interpolation, then straight sRGB RGBA8 encoding.
numerical_policy.quantization: Use ties-to-even rounding to match the existing Python numerical reference.
numerical_policy.unknown: Both-unknown remains RGBA zero; partial support is a display fade, never a newly observed surface.

verification.baseline_schedule: Reuse all 98 frozen development target cases, with fixed source geometry and common UV.
verification.raw_exports: Persist every exported embedded PNG and independently decode raw RGBA; canvas-domain equality alone is insufficient.
verification.resource_and_restore: Check mode clear, ordinary texture path, model replacement and disposal; close owned loopback servers and browsers.

limits: Fixed geometry, software WebGL and quantized image samples cannot establish real age/identity quality or universal mathematical/rendered continuity.
